title: 第9章 白虎堂
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

众人齐齐转头。

见沈哥拎着一盒东西站在巷口，看不清表情，但那股由内而外的气势，压得巷子里的空气都沉了几分。

老光脸色骤变，赶紧收起满脸凶相，，“沈哥误会了，我这次是路过，来找林兄弟增进增进感情。”

几个小喽啰也纷纷把手从刀柄上挪开，讪笑着附和，

“是啊沈哥，你误会了。”

“我们只是找他聊聊。”

“增进感情？”

沈哥指了指地上的米袋，又扫了一眼林珝门口插着的那把刀，

“什么感情需要聊到动刀子？还把人家米给扛出来了？”

老光脸上的笑容更僵硬了，咽了口唾沫讪笑说，“是……屋里太潮了，我们打算帮他晒晒。”

他支支吾吾地往后退，一边招呼小弟们赶紧走。

几个小喽啰灰溜溜地丢下米袋，再次夹着尾巴跑了。

沈哥没有再说什么，扫过林珝钉在门上的腰刀，

“山寨的赏赐是你应得的，但能不能守住，还得看你自己的本事。”

林珝听懂了这句话里的弦外之音。

他点了点头，一言不发地把米袋重新扛回屋里，一袋一袋码好。

那把腰刀仍旧插在门口的木板。

谁再敢不打招呼就进门拿东西，这把刀就是回应。

沈哥看在眼里，眼底掠过一丝不易察觉的赞许，

“还算有点血性，没丢你爹的脸。”

林珝扛完最后一袋米，拍了拍手上的麸皮，

“沈哥，你来找我，应该不是为了看老光闹这一出吧。”

沈哥也不拐弯，把手里的木盒递过去，“两件事，首先是奉三小姐的命，来看看你死了没有。”

林珝一愣，

药膏的质地比他花钱换来的好了不少，透着一股冰片和麝香的气味。

在这种战乱区，一瓶上好的金疮药，可比那二两银子更贵重。

这女人到底几个意思？

他掂了掂手里的药盒，脑子里有点犯懵。

想起苏悦那张永远挂着寒意的脸，有点吃不准。

沈哥看他接了药，才不紧不慢地往下说，“还有个事，上次你杀了乌勒斥候，按寨子的规矩，可以让你当个小头目。”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Everyone turned their heads.

I saw Brother Shen standing at the entrance of the alley carrying a box of things. I couldn't see his expression clearly, but the aura from the inside out made the air in the alley feel a little heavier.

Lao Guang's expression suddenly changed, and he quickly put away his fierce expression, "Brother Shen misunderstood, I am passing by this time to come to Brother Lin to enhance our relationship."

Several young men also removed their hands from the handle of the knife and laughed in agreement.

"Yes, Brother Shen, you misunderstood."

"We were just chatting with him."

"Enhancing feelings?"

Brother Shen pointed to the rice bag on the ground and glanced at the knife stuck at Lin Jue's door.

"What kind of relationship needs to be discussed to the point of going under the knife? And you have to carry out other people's rice?"

The smile on Lao Guang's face became even stiffer. He swallowed and said with a smile, "Yes...it's too humid in the room. We plan to help him bask in the sun."

He hesitated and backed away, calling for his younger brothers to leave quickly.

Several minions dropped their rice bags dejectedly and ran away again with their tails between their legs.

Brother Shen didn't say anything else. He glanced at Lin Sui's waist knife nailed to the door.

"You deserve the reward of the copycat, but whether you can hold on to it depends on your own ability."

Lin Jue understood the implication of this sentence.

He nodded, and without saying a word, he carried the rice bags back into the house and stacked them one by one.

The belt knife was still inserted into the wooden board of the door.

If anyone dares to come in and get something without saying hello, this knife is the answer.

Brother Shen saw this, and there was a trace of imperceptible approval in his eyes.

"It's quite bloody, and it didn't disgrace your father."

Lin Jue finished carrying the last bag of rice and patted the bran on his hands.

"Brother Shen, you didn't come to me just to see Lao Guang causing trouble."

Brother Shen didn't turn around and handed over the wooden box in his hand, "Two things. First, I'm here to see if you're dead on the orders of the third lady."

Lin Jue was stunned.

The texture of the ointment was much better than what he paid for, and it smelled of borneol and musk.

In such a war-torn area, a bottle of good gold sore medicine is more valuable than two taels of silver.

What does this woman mean?

He weighed the pill box in his hand, feeling a little confused.

Thinking of Su Yue's face that always had a chill on it, I was a little unsure.

Brother Shen watched him take the medicine and then continued slowly, "One more thing. Last time you killed Scout Ule, according to the rules of the village, you can be made a minor leader."
